body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Smart-Leaf by Originatic(www.smart-leaf.com) presented its all-in-one computer model 'Oasis' at the CES 2009.
Equipped with its standard, spill-proof keyboard and integrated touch pad, the Smart-Leaf Oasis is ideal for personal and professional use in the home and work place.
